link_description: Resources and data must support creation of a usable knowledge platform
Users must contribute and reuse knowledge for the platform to matter
Knowledge reuse must improve decision quality rather than merely document volume
Participation must create legitimacy by influencing decisions
Service redesign must reduce user burden without shifting burden to frontline teams
Foresight outputs must be used in real decisions before crisis conditions
Scenario readiness must improve resilience across plausible futures
Performance targets must improve outcomes rather than metric gaming
Short-term metric movement must reflect real progress
AI workflow must expand strategic idea space rather than recycle familiar frames
Human review must turn AI outputs into better strategic options
Cross-functional governance must reduce alignment drift
Small pilots must generate evidence relevant to scaling decisions
Portfolio governance must stop weak pilots rather than defending sunk costs
Equity review must influence decisions rather than become compliance ritual
Burden and harm must be visible early enough to alter implementation
